info.title: StockQuant Historical Fake Execution Internal API
info.description: Historical replay only. All execution is through the isolated FakeBroker; real brokers and LIVE execution are excluded.

post.summary: Authorize and execute one idempotent historical order through FakeBroker

requestBody.description: The authorizationId is validated by Governance before any FakeBroker write. Reuse namespace/clientOrderId only with the identical semantic payload.

200.description: Persisted FakeBroker result or idempotent replay

403.description: Service identity or governance authorization rejected

409.description: Idempotency identity reused with a different payload

422.description: Invalid execution command or failed ledger delivery
